node.title: Non-quotient e1-collisions mod p <=> p divides an explicit bounded nonzero norm
node.statement: For B != B' non-quotient-related: e1(B) = e1(B') mod frak-p iff frak-p | (e1(B)-e1(B')) in Z[zeta_N'], a NONZERO (by thm:upstairs) cyclotomic integer with all archimedean conjugates <= 2l'. Hence zone-(b) = counting prime divisors of an explicit bounded-height difference family.
